exposure: midwifery and nursing interventions to limit COVID-19 transmission
SARS-CoV-2 infection during third trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Clinical characteristics of COVID-19 infection in pregnancy
cohort: 35 women in their third trimester of pregnancy with SARS-CoV-2, admitted to one hospital in Wuhan, China
finding: Implementation of specific midwifery and nursing care strategies for pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection in their third trimester was associated with no maternal complications or nosocomial infections.
mod_finding: The majority of women in the study (31 out of 35) had a cesarean section.
